title: Materials demonstration — QSCI on real Sn-oxide fragments (new avenue from Juan/Fares workflow)
rationale: Juan active-space estimates map SnO->16q, SnO2->20q; our validated QSCI engine applies directly, bridging hydrogen-chain scaling (Track A) to EUV materials relevance (Track B).
method: PySCF RHF with def2-ECP on Sn -> CASCI(active space) -> OpenFermion JW qubit Hamiltonian (construction validated on H4 to 0.0000 mHa) -> QSCI selected-CI vs FCI(CASCI).
significance: Chemical accuracy on ACTUAL EUV-relevant Sn-oxide chemistry (not abstract H chains), connecting the scaling engine to the Mitsubishi/AIST materials target. Same QSCI-proxy caveat applies; demonstrates the evaluation layer on the real chemistry.
